chunk_selection: uniform over each train video's timestamped ASR chunks
image: one ffmpeg-decoded midpoint frame per selected chunk, RGB thumbnail at most 224x224
system_instruction: Score observable evidence only. Output exactly Yes or No.
user_template: <image> Excerpt: {ASR text}\nQuestion: {axis question}\nIs this evidence present? Answer exactly Yes or No.
readout: single-token Yes-vs-No next-token log-odds minus the corresponding [NO CONTENT] gray-image null log-odds, followed by sigmoid
decoding: none; one forward pass over next-token logits
